text: I was quite wary of going to a place, especially a dentist, that I’d never even seen. But the opportunity to have a holiday in Thailand and get dental work done at half the price of home (Aotearoa New Zealand) was too good to pass up. From my first email contact with the clinic, through Dr Ilian, was prompt, clear and friendly. The clinic itself is a joy - beautiful and relaxing and the staff  are so lovely and friendly. Dr Ann was excellent. We had a good discussion about options and came up with a plan that prioritised the most pressing work in the very short time I had available. Throughout the process, when needed, Dr Ann discussed risks, options and next steps. I had two very old fillings replaced and crowns fitted. There was very little in the way of discomfort, no pain, and I’m very pleased with the end result. I’m intending to come back here for any future work.
Came here from UK for composite bonding on February 26th. Staff are very friendly and amazing work from Dr Chicha!

I had a wisdom tooth cutting into my cheek and was quite nervous about seeing a dentist in Phuket. I chose this clinic based on the great reviews, and they are definitely justified!
The staff members were professional and respectful, and the doctor was very patient, explaining everything clearly. The tooth extraction treatment was fast and completely painless. I paid thorough my insurance but even without insurance, the prices are very fair. Highly recommended!

I would give this dentist a 10 star if I could. I’m originally from London, I had a gum graft did with this Dr Ann. A gum graft isn’t an easy procedure nor is it cheap in the UK. I can’t thank her enough, she did an OUTSTANDING job on my gums. The follow ups after the surgery were amazing too, at each follow up the doctor has spent nearly one hour checking my gums cleaning them making sure the graft is a success. The cost was amazing too. I can’t thank them enough. If you want to have any treatment done I highly recommend this dentist. I will be forever grateful for what you have done for me. I hope god blesses you all. Great dentist and dental nurses. With lots of love, Shima ❤️❤️

Dr Ann and the team looked after me from start to finish. Root planing. Extraction. Bone graft.

They are wonderful beautiful people who care about their patients.

They are the utmost professionals.

I highly recommend their wonderful clinic.

Dr Ann and her staff are amazing. They are so helpful and always ready to schedule appointments to suit me. As fir the quality of service, it is first class. This is my 4th visit to her clinic. My teeth look and feel perfect. I am totally satisfied. I recommend Dr. Ann, and Dental Sea Clinic to anyone who is visiting Thailand for any kind of dental procedure. Highly recommended.

Wow !

Another superb experience at the dental sea clinic. Most of us tend to anxious of visiting the dentist.

At dental sea they make you feel calm and peaceful before getting to work on your teeth, and they also educates you on how to better maintain your awesome teeth.

The dentists and the staff are professional. What I appreciate most is that they care for the patient above all. Thank you dental sea.

I would highly recommend Dental Sea clinic. My tooth chipped while on holidays and they sorted everything for me. I am very nervous of dentists and have a huge fear of them.  Everyone there put me at ease and made me feel calm. Very gentle doctors and I felt no pain at all.

Dr. Ann is the kindest and most knowledgeable dentist I've ever met. And I have lived in London, Singapore and California. She is absolutely amongst the top dentists compared with doctors I've encountered in all the top private clinic networks worldwide.

My dad had a dental emergency right before the new year, I called ~10 clinics in Phuket in the early evening and they were either closed or fully booked. Dr. Ann's office was the only one that added an emergency slot the next morning for us. She is incredibly patient and answered all of our questions with excellent clarity.

My dad's travel insurance didn't cover dental cost, and Dr. Ann charged us such a modest fee it felt impossible. She said that she lived in Japan in the past and she knew how expensive dental treatment could be, she charges the same fee for Thai people and for foreigners because she wants everyone to be able to afford dental care. We felt extremely lucky to have her taking care of my dad and she did a stellar job fixing his tooth.

Thank you Dr. Ann!!

I have the best dental experience here at dental Sea. I don’t usually do reviews but they deserve it so much. Me and my husband were just traveling Thailand from New Zealand when I had a tooth ache. Researched and saw Dental sea and walked in. They were very accommodating. Everyone from the reception to the dentists and dental assistants just are welcoming and know what they’re doing. I had 3 root canal treatment, post, extraction and a flexi denture. I never wanted to visit the dentist coz of how scary it is. And I heard root canal is painful. But they did a great job. It was painless and don’t need pain relievers. The dentists did a good job with everything and working around our travel schedule. Went out of their way to accommodate the urgency of the treatment. And had my crowns done in time. I now have a beautiful time with 1/3 of the price than in NZ. I highly recommend them and will come back for more. Not scared of the dentist anymore coz of Dental Sea ♥️

Having abused my teeth for decades I needed a great deal of work. I heard about Dental Sea Clinic and have to state that it was such an amazing experience. Not only was it a third of the price I would have paid at home but the experience, and expertise of the doctors and nurses was second to none. Both my wife and I had extensive work and have had no problems at all. In fact we returned last month and continued to complete the work required. I have complete faith in Dental Sea Clinic as they are very well qualified and trained, and have top products and equipment- and then there is the lovely Thai smile!

I'm 69 years old Canadian , just had an implant done by Dr.Ann
at DentalSea clinic about 2 month ago, and just can't praise enough.
Dr. Ann very personal & warm attitude paired with vast knowledge and experience, topped with problem-solving gusto made this dental operation into very good experience.
Also it was painless, mended fast  and I'll probably come back next winter for more.

Me and my husband flew in from New Zealand, needing to get alot of work done in a short window of 2 weeks. Not only was the outcome of a extremely high standard, it also took a short amount of time that allowed us alot of time to explore the area and get lots of shopping done. The service was also amazing and our specialist (Dr. Ann) was exceptionally organized and made the experience very enjoyable.
Thank you DentalSea, see you again next year!

As an expat, living abroad I feared having dental work done, that was until I consulted with Dr. Ann. She is professional, polite, very thorough, and conscientious. I had extensive work done on, from Gingivitis to making bridges and crowns. I'm very grateful for her work. I have a wonderful, handsome smile.

Recently had a wisdom tooth that was causing me lots of pain removed here - I have to say, Dental Sea clinic really deserves its 5 star rating! The doctors and staff were incredibly welcoming and professional, and the entire operation took less than 30 minutes (and most of that was waiting for the local anesthesia to kick in!). The premises are very clean and comfortable, and there is free wi-fi available. Like other reviewers mentioned, the prices are also notably a great deal even compared to those of surrounding clinics/the hospital I contacted. For my very first (scary!!) dental surgery, I couldn't have hoped for a better and more comfortable experience :) Thank you Dental Sea Clinic! I'll definitely be coming here for my future dental needs when I'm in Phuket.

Finally over my fear of dentists, well sort of. Dr Ann and her team are great have been a number of times over the past 8 years always happy with the standard of work. They go above and beyond to get a great outcome for you. Have a a variety of treatments for all of our family. From caps being replaced to dental implants and check up and cleans. Well worth the trip.

I had my top dentures done...my dentist and her team were awesome,  filling me in with every detail along the way so I never felt invaded. ..they worked around my holiday schedule only giving them 8 days to complete the work which should have taken at least 12-14 days..I was very happy with the work done and give them a thumbs up. ..tks dentslsea
I was here for the first time today for a Chechup and teeth cleaning. Very friendly, everything was wonderful. Thank you, I definitely recommend it! Frank

I had 10 crowns along with extensive other work over 10 days in 2015 on a referral from a friend now 3 year's later I'm still extremely happy with the quality & price l paid for Dr Ann's professional service,l highly recommend  this clinic.

Dr Ann and crew are extremely knowledgeable and friendly.
If you are in Patong and need any dental work done DentalSea is the place to go!
Very good dentist & staff, I got a cleaning and I am going back for a whitening. …
I have a cracked tooth and thay fixed it no problem so soft no pain I am so happy highly recommended and cheep as chips  compare to to Australia prices
Dr. Suthin fixed a chipped molar and did some fillings for me... she and her staff were very kind and did an amazing job!

Absolutely amazing..I tried to organise time before I arrived but never heard back..however when I got there walked in and got an appointment ..did all the work I needed to be out of pain and I will go back to fix up the little bits and pieces.best prices and best service!!!

Simply wow!

perfect approach to the patient, practically painless procedure - for the first time in my life I didn't even feel the numbing injection. The price was OK too. I recommend this clinic to everyone !!!!!
